meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Discover, vet, and install agent skills by searching ACROSS every major registry at once — skills.sh, clawhub.ai, and GitHub — presenting each board on its own native metric (installs / stars) with the top entry per board, security-scanning the top candidates' real SKILL.md for risky patterns, and flagging what's already installed. Use when the user asks "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that…", "what skill should I install for…", or wants to extend the agent with a capability that might already exist as a published skill. Unlike single-registry search, this surfaces the best of every platform side by side, so you recommend the genuinely relevant, popular, well-maintained, and SAFE one — not whatever ranked first on one site.

copy.tagline: 跨注册表搜索、审查并安装 agent 技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个技能市场里找到安全可靠的技能来扩展 agent。
copy.tagline_en: Search, vet, and install agent skills across registries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find safe, reliable skills across multiple registries to extend your agent.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以同时搜索 skills.sh、clawhub.ai 和 GitHub 三大技能库，按各自指标（安装量/星数）展示每个库的最佳结果，并安全扫描候选技能的 SKILL.md 文件，标记已安装的技能。
howto.when: 当用户询问“如何做某事”、“找某个技能”、“有没有技能可以…”或想扩展 Claude 能力时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个能处理 PDF 表单的技能。
say.note: Claude 会搜索所有库并推荐最佳选项。

say.text: 有没有用于前端设计的技能？
say.note: Claude 会展示各库的头部结果并给出推荐。

say.text: 搜索视频生成相关的技能。
say.note: Claude 会并行搜索并安全扫描候选。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search skills.sh, clawhub.ai, and GitHub simultaneously, show the top result per registry by its native metric (installs/stars), security-scan the SKILL.md of top candidates, and flag already installed skills.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that…", or wants to extend the agent with a published skill.

say_en.text: Find a skill for handling PDF forms.
say_en.note: Claude will search all registries and recommend the best.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for frontend design?
say_en.note: Claude will show top results from each board and give a recommendation.
Claude will search in parallel and security-scan candidates.
